intent: Open the saved report 'Untriaged intake'; for each ticket in it, open it, set its milestone, add the comment 'Triaged.', submit, and go back to the report through View Tickets, until none are left.
second_installation: the Trac UI in German (trac.ini [trac] default_language = de)

verify_yaml.first:
schema_version: openadapt.verify/v1
app:
  name: Trac service desk (local test copy)
  url: http://127.0.0.1:9485/report/9
  version: trac@1.6
  session: benchmark.onboarding_effort.hooks:open_session
  reset:
    python: benchmark.onboarding_effort.hooks:reset
verifier:
  kind: sql
  sqlite_database: /Users/abrichr/oa/scratch/onboarding-effort/trac-db/trac.db
  sql_query: "SELECT '#' || id AS ticket, milestone, component FROM ticket"
effects:
  - kind: field_equals
    match: {ticket: {param: ticket}}
    field: milestone
    value: {param: milestone}
save_step: auto
inputs:
  source: recorded
campaign:
  id: onboarding-tr-triage-loop-first
  trials: 3
  policy: permissive
